correction.falsifier: The reconciled lifecycle identities or source hashes fail independent reconstruction from the retained BRENTOIL live ledgers.

live_canary_execution_baseline.interpretation: Venue execution and liquidity are empirically established. Mixed strategy identities, two operator exits, and largest-winner dependence prevent attributing a profitable automatic edge to the retired routes.

source_adapter_fix.defect: The public candle adapter ignored the requested 5m timeframe and fetched 15m rows.
source_adapter_fix.resolution: The adapter now maps and validates 1m, 5m, and 15m explicitly; the corrected v3 parity artifact replaced the invalid v2 interpretation.
source_adapter_fix.validation: Seven focused timeframe/parity tests and the affected 28-test source suite passed.

hypothesis_ledger.reason: Nominal development is positive, but conservative live-tail stress, path completeness, candle parity, and prospective eligible lifecycle evidence are not sufficient.
Two attributable canary trades were net negative with profit factor below one.
One manually closed largest-winner-dependent lifecycle cannot reverse independent rejection.
Frozen mechanism development and stress evidence were not robust.
The positive slice was post-hoc and remains descriptive until prospectively predeclared evidence exists.

next_investigation.5_applicable_conditions: Fresh symmetric 5m oil-shock onset under the frozen 12-bar return and 2016-bar q95 threshold.
next_investigation.6_alternatives_considered: Retired swing, retired breakout, CL transfer, and a post-hoc session filter; none currently support activation.

next_investigation.9_downside_risk: Sparse onsets may delay diagnosis; one or two favorable lifecycles could produce false confidence; market gaps can censor paths.
next_investigation.10_validation_results: Four complete bars have resolved mark/L2 paths; corrected candle parity is 3/4; lifecycle evaluation is waiting with zero eligible onsets.
next_investigation.11_oos_status: Validation and holdout remain sealed and were not accessed.
next_investigation.12_success_criteria: At minimum observe a fully attributable resolved lifecycle on each side, then require stress and largest-winner sensitivity before requesting any OOS opening or live change.
next_investigation.13_rollback_or_invalidation: No rollback is needed because nothing is live. Identity/hash mismatch, unresolved entry/exit paths, source-candle mismatch, or materially worse realized costs invalidate the window.
next_investigation.14_confidence: High on data availability and execution-cost attribution; low on strategy edge due zero prospective eligible lifecycles.
